run_text_clustering_pipeline: run a text clustering pipeline on a HuggingFace dataset using DBSCAN and save cluster results
build_hf_data_clusters: build a HuggingFace dataset containing cluster summaries and examples from a ClusterClassifier object
build_hf_data_files: build a HuggingFace dataset with file projections, labels, and content from a ClusterClassifier
infer_cluster_labels: run inference on new texts using a loaded clustering pipeline and push results to HuggingFace Hub
extract_res: extract category and educational score from a cluster summary string
